notes.title: It will be changed to a free game, and the game name has also been changed.
notes.content:
It will be changed to a free game
After consideration, it has been decided to convert the game into a free one. The main reasons are as follows: 
1. The "Era of SkyTree" project has been terminated. It will be changed to the game "JOJOvsDIO".
2. "JOJOvsDIO" is a re-creation action game based on the theme of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. To allow more players and the fans of JoJo to play this game, it will be released for free.
3. The free change and name change are expected to be completed within two months. Please stay tuned!!! 
Thank you very much for your support and encouragement.
